links.outcome: External-site AUROC of ICU readmission/mortality models versus internal performance
links.effect: Weighted AUROC on AUMC data: local MSZ 69.7%, OLVG 70.5%, AUMC (internal) 76.5%; pooled MSZ+OLVG model 71.1%. The internal-external gap shrank when cardiac surgery patients were excluded.
links.quote: Performance evaluation of the local models on AUMC data demonstrated weighted area under the receiver operating characteristic curves of 69.7 %±0.8 %, 70.5 %±0.5 %, and 76.5 %±1.9 %, respectively, whereas the pooled model achieved a weighted area under the receiver operating characteristic curves of 71.1 %±0.7 %.

unlisted_practices: Training a pooled multi-hospital model to improve external generalizability
Using an autoencoder out-of-distribution detector to capture dataset heterogeneity

screen.reason: The study empirically tests multi-hospital pooled model development versus local models and evaluates out-of-distribution detection to address dataset heterogeneity and external generalizability across clinical settings.

primary.practice: multi-center pooling and out-of-distribution detection for external generalizability
